The complete source operands independently establish one actual recorded presentation Meeting per CR here, so max does not invent a terminal chain or select an arbitrary meeting from competing presentations. Multiple Spec editions and duplicate joins cannot inflate the requested ten.

The uncapped reference query retains the complete recorded target-CR rank pool; top_k_boundary_ties selects min(10,population) without a date cutoff, LIMIT-generated arbitrary boundary membership, minimum count, latest release, or submitted-only restriction.
